tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Inset list sections, cards and sheets that are not glass.

tokens.name: surface-grouped
tokens.usage: Page background behind grouped lists and glass. The default ground.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus, and the opaque stand-in for every glass surface when Liquid Glass is off.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Glass with Liquid Glass on where refraction is unavailable (Safari, Firefox): blurred fallback. Always with blur-glass.

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Glass that carries small text: tab bars, search fields, toolbars, list sections on busy backgrounds.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Tint over REFRACTING glass (lens on, regular strength). The lens does the work; the tint only warms it. Large text and glyphs only.

tokens.name: glass-tint-strong
tokens.usage: Tint over refracting glass that carries small text (tab bars, search, glass lists); label and label-secondary read on it with lens-frost-strong behind.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Pointer-following specular sheen on refracting glass while hovered.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: 0.5px rim around every glass surface; catches light at the edge.

tokens.name: glass-selection
tokens.usage: Selected item pill inside glass (the active tab).

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Off switch track, unfilled slider track.

tokens.name: fill-tertiary
tokens.usage: Segmented control track, pressed row highlight.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: 0.5px hairlines between list rows. Decorative, never the only divider of meaning.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-grouped, surface-elevated and any glass fill.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, row detail values, list headers and footers, placeholders. 4.5:1+ on surface, surface-grouped and glass-fill-strong in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue as a FILL: filled buttons, slider fill, selection. Pair with on-accent text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent and danger fills (4.7:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Blue as TEXT: links, plain and tinted buttons, active tab label. Reads on surface, surface-grouped, accent-tint and glass-fill-strong.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted button background, carrying accent-text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus outline, offset 2px. 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Switch and slider thumbs, segmented selection in light mode. Always with shadow-knob.

tokens.name: seg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected segment of a segmented control, carrying label.

tokens.name: switch-on
tokens.usage: On switch track. Below 3:1 on white, so state is also carried by knob position; never use this green alone to signal anything.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success copy and success icon squares, always with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill with on-accent text.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Destructive text actions and error copy on surface and surface-grouped.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning copy, always paired with a word.

tokens.name: wall-blue
tokens.usage: Wallpaper and identity color: cover blocks, stage orbs behind glass, settings icon squares (white glyph, 3.6:1).

tokens.name: wall-indigo
tokens.usage: Wallpaper color, icon squares with white glyph.

tokens.name: wall-pink
tokens.usage: Wallpaper color, icon squares with white glyph.

tokens.name: wall-yellow
tokens.usage: Wallpaper color only. Never a white-glyph icon square (fails contrast).

tokens.name: wall-teal
tokens.usage: Wallpaper color only. Never behind white text.

families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro", system-ui, "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.text: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro", system-ui, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.rounded: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: One per screen, the collapsing navigation title.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section titles inside a scroll view.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Button labels, emphasized row titles, inline navigation title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Row titles and running text. The default.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: List headers and footers, segmented control labels.

styles.name: caption-2
styles.usage: Tab bar labels. Nothing smaller exists.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Big glanceable numbers in widgets and stat cards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside tabs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls, glass bar inner padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row icon to title gap, card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin, row horizontal padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, inset list side margin on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a list section header.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between unrelated groups.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target in both directions. Rows and buttons never go below it.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: 29px settings icon squares.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips, menus items, text fields inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, inner cards nested in a radius-lg container.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inset list sections, glass cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and large panels; concentric with a phone corner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, search fields, segmented controls, tab bars, switches.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Lift under every floating glass surface.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-edge
tokens.usage: Specular top edge on glass, combined with shadow-glass.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: Switch knob, slider thumb, selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-solid
tokens.usage: Lift under floating surfaces when Liquid Glass is off.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for glass-fill, with saturate(180%).

tokens.name: blur-glass-strong
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for glass-fill-strong.

tokens.name: lens-bezel
tokens.usage: Width of the curved rim that bends light, inward from the edge. Clamped to half the short side.

tokens.name: lens-depth
tokens.usage: Peak displacement at the rim, in px: how far the thickest bend shifts what is behind the glass.

tokens.name: lens-ior
tokens.usage: Index of refraction (crown glass). Higher bends more.

tokens.name: lens-aberration
tokens.usage: Chromatic dispersion: red and blue channels are displaced this fraction more and less than green.

tokens.name: lens-frost
tokens.usage: Blur inside regular refracting glass, so the center stays clear and the rim does the lensing.

tokens.name: lens-frost-strong
tokens.usage: Blur inside text-bearing refracting glass so small text stays legible.

tokens.name: lens-specular
tokens.usage: Strength of the rim highlight (light from the top left, a softer bounce bottom right).

tokens.name: lens-saturation
tokens.usage: Saturation boost applied to the refracted backdrop.
